_how_to_use: Copy to <project>/references/part_spec.json and fill in from the Expanded criteria table.
One entry per feature, each with the source of its numbers, same vocabulary as 02 A00:
thickness and depth are Z; width and length are in the top view's plane.
x and y are the feature's CENTRE, measured from the datum below.
Then: tools/sketch.py -> audit(spec) to check it in text, write_svg(spec, path) to draw it.
details: a zoomed panel per small feature, so a 3 mm question is legible on a long part.
from_edge picks which edge the caliper sits on; it defaults to the datum edge.
constants / companions / mates / linked "=" values: see _EXAMPLE_part_spec.json.
Delete this key once the file is filled in.

questions.about: <feature id, or omit and give region instead>
questions.text: one question, answerable with yes or a correction (02 A01)

details.title: A
details.text: what to measure, and which candidate value each reading would confirm
